description: For learners who can already do the component skills, a short time-boxed cycle around one scoped deliverable, with criteria set before work starts, a mid-cycle review and revision, and an unhurried structured debrief, is expected to build whole-task skill better than open-ended projects or isolated exercises; no claim in the wiki tests sprints, and the evidence is on goals, feedback, coaching, reflection and time pressure in other settings.
title: Skills Sprint
